title: REPORT on the Council position on Draft amending budget No 3/2026 of the European Union for the financial year 2026 – Adjustments in expenditure, update of revenues and other technical updates
part_text: 5. Welcomes the reintroduction of the suspended commitments for the years 2024 and 2025 under the Hungarian cohesion policy programmes following the lifting of the relevant Council decision; recalls that, once the suspension has been lifted, the corresponding commitments are to be re-entered in the Union budget in accordance with the applicable legal framework; stresses that access to those appropriations should not be delayed by additional political conditions or requirements not laid down in the applicable legislation; calls for their transparent, lawful and timely implementation;
